hooks.command: npm run lint > /dev/null 2>&1 && npm test > /dev/null 2>&1 || echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Pre-push checks failed — run npm run lint && npm test to see errors."}'

python3 -c "
import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
f = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if '/specs/spec.' in f:
    print('{\"systemMessage\": \"Spec file changed \u2014 consider running /spec-lint to check for inconsistencies.\"}')
" 2>/dev/null || true
r=$(gh run list --repo chrismarksus/ScrumChartBoard --limit 3 2>&1 || true); R="$r" node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({systemMessage:"CI status after push:\n"+process.env.R}))'
